Container.Name: WooSarr
Container.Overview:
WooSarr is a Plex user and library management system with Seerr integration for media requests, driven by your Discord server.
**Features** - **Discord roles → Plex libraries.** Map roles to one or more libraries; members get every library their roles give. Grants are additive: losing one role only removes a library if nothing else keeps it. - **Link Discord users to Plex accounts.** Members link themselves with /link (Sign in with Plex = verified, or by typing their username); admins link anyone from the web UI or with /link. - **Invite Discord users to Plex.** Admins (and, optionally, members) send Plex invites with /invite; the libraries come from the member's roles and the account links itself when accepted. - **Shared Plex accounts.** Several Discord members can share one Plex account, which gets the libraries all their roles give. - **Mass actions and manual grants.** Add or remove libraries for many Plex users at once, or add and remove Discord roles for many members. - **Exemptions.** Exempt libraries are never touched by roles. - **Reaction posts and custom emoji.** Members react to a post to get a role; add emoji to your server from emoji.gg, OpenMoji and slackmojis. - **Requests through Seerr.** Members request movies and shows with /request (or a pasted IMDb, TMDB or TVDB link) as their own Seerr user, hear back when it's available, and failed requests are retried. - **Starts in dry-run.** See exactly what would change before anything does, with impact previews before every change and a full audit trail. - **Web UI on port 31337:** customizable dashboard, alerts, live logs, light/dark themes and colour-vision palettes, admin sign-in with a password or single sign-on (Okta, Entra ID, Google, ADFS, any OIDC provider).
Setup: open the WebUI with the first-run setup code from the container log. Documentation: https://github.com/WoosArr/woosarr
Container.Changes:
### 1.2.0 (2026-11-12) Admins can link members and choose admin roles from Discord, accepted invites link within a minute and get a welcome DM, `/request` takes pasted IMDb, TMDB and TVDB links and retries failed requests, a Custom Emoji page, deleted libraries and roles are cleaned up, TrueNAS and Proxmox install guides, many dashboard additions, and security fixes (no username enumeration at sign-in, no link text on the login page, secrets kept out of logs, Debian security updates in the image). Update by pulling `latest` (or `1.2.0`).
Full changelog: https://github.com/WoosArr/woosarr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Container.Requires: A Plex server you own (WooSarr signs in as the owner) and a Discord bot application with the Server Members Intent turned on. Seerr is optional (for /request).
